Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Collins
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver
Date: 02/11/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 313 as introduced (1) authorizes the Alabama Board of Chiropractic Examiners to purchase real property to be used by the board to carry out its responsibilities with board funds and (2) provides that any debts, obligations, or liabilities incurred through the purchase of such property is the sole responsibility of the Board. This bill will not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Collins
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver
Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 313 as passed the House of Representatives authorizes the Alabama Board of Chiropractic Examiners to purchase real property. This bill also provides that property will be purchased solely with board funds and that any debts, obligations, or liabilities incurred through the purchase of real property is the sole responsibility of the Board. This bill could also reduce ad valorem tax receipts to the state (currently distributed to the Public School Fund, the Public Welfare Trust Fund, Alabama Veterans Assistance Fund and the State General Fund) and to local governments by an undetermined amount dependent upon the value of the property purchased by the Board and the applicable millage rates.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
